acceptance_threshold: non-empty; ntd_id and report_year present; deadhead columns parse.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- an agency-year economics panel. Consumed by outreach/build_peer_insight.py for peer-relative benchmarking and by the NTD monthly model.
derived_artifacts: GOVERNANCE-ONLY MANIFEST (tools/build_realdata_manifests.py). These bytes were hand-acquired before the governed estate existed and live at the paths below. Nothing was moved, copied or re-downloaded, and NO .acquired.json record is written -- this dataset did not go through packages.estate.acquire, and claiming it did would forge the provenance the estate exists to make trustworthy.
geography: United States, nationwide -- all NTD-reporting agencies.
license_and_commercial_rights: Public Domain U.S. Government work. NTD data is published by FTA for unrestricted public use including commercial use. Agency-level operating and service statistics; no personal data of any kind.
owner_and_source: Federal Transit Administration, National Transit Database -- the agency economics extract in ntd/agency_economics.csv, derived from published NTD annual tables.
retention_and_deletion: retained as committed evidence; public-domain federal data.
schema_and_format: CSV, one row per agency per report year, with deadhead, opex, trips and derived per-trip and per-hour economics.
time_coverage: report years 2022-2024; 2024 is the only year with full coverage.
update_frequency: annual upstream; local copy is a static snapshot.
